description: NaCrF₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent CrF₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one CrF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-39°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.44 Å. Cr is bonded to six F atoms to form CrF₆ octahedra that share corners with five equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Cr-F bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.81 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Cr atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Cr atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Cr atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Cr atom.
